metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 1993 · Crayon Shin-chan: Action Kamen vs. Demon
metas.description: Action Kamen comes to Shinchan's world seeking help from Shinchan to defeat the Haigure Demon. Then the adventure of Shinchan and his family begins.

metas.description: Shinchan and his lookalike embarks on a journey to defeat forces of a ruthless leader Mr. Anaconda and his forces.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.1 · 1997 · Crayon Shin-chan: Pursuit of the Balls of Darkness
metas.description: The Nohara family gets involved in a dispute between two clans who are fighting to possess a sphere claimed to be able to bring back to life a powerful evil spirit.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.8 · 1998 · Crayon Shin-chan: Blitzkrieg! Pig's Hoof's Secret Mission

metas.description: A secret hot spring protection organization kidnaps Shinchan and his family, convinced a legendary underground golden hot spring lies beneath their home. Their quest quickly spirals into an all out adventurous battle against Yuzame.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 7.2 · 2000 · Keriyon Shin-chan: Oh, I'm Sorry!
metas.description: The Noharas go on an Action Mask-themed cruise, where all the grown-ups get kidnapped by a gang of monkeys. It's up to the kids to rescue them!

metas.name: 9 · ★ 7.8 · 2001 · Shin Chan: The Adult Empire Strikes Back
metas.description: When a new threat regresses the minds of the adults of Kasukabe back into children, its up to Shinnosuke and his friends to reclaim their parents from becoming trapped in the nostalgia of the 20th Century.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 7.4 · 2002 · Crayon Shin-chan: Fierceness That Invites Storm! The Battle of the Warring States
metas.description: Shin-chan somehow travels back in time, where he promptly involves himself in samurai wars and political intrigue, changing history left and right!

metas.name: 11 · ★ 6.8 · 2003 · Crayon Shin-chan: Fierceness That Invites Storm! Yakiniku Road of Glory
metas.description: It's yakiniku night for the Noharas. But before they can dig in, they get wrapped up in a sizzling conspiracy and are forced to go on the run.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 6.8 · 2004 · Crayon Shin-chan: Invoke a Storm! The Kasukabe Boys of the Evening Sun
metas.description: At a strange movie theater, everyone gets sucked into the film they're watching. The longer they stay, the less they remember about the real world!

metas.name: 13 · ★ 5.5 · 2005 · Crayon Shin-chan: The Legend Called Buri Buri 3 Minutes Charge
metas.description: After a noodle-loving time traveler shows up, Shin-chan and his parents transform into superheroes, fighting monsters three minutes in the future!

metas.name: 14 · ★ 6.2 · 2006 · Crayon Shin-chan: Densetsu wo yobu odore! Amîgo!

metas.name: 15 · ★ 5.9 · 2007 · Crayon Shin-chan: Fierceness That Invites Storm! The Singing Buttocks Bomb

metas.name: 16 · ★ 5.7 · 2008 · Crayon Shin-chan: Fierceness That Invites Storm! The Hero of Kinpoko

metas.name: 18 · ★ 6.9 · 2010 · Crayon Shinchan Super Dimension the Storm Called My Bride

metas.name: 20 · ★ 6.0 · 2012 · Eiga Kureyon Shinchan: Arashi o yobu! Ora to uchuu to purinsesu
21 · ★ 6.7 · 2013 · Crayon Shin-chan: Very Tasty! B-class Gourmet Survival!!

metas.name: 22 · ★ 7.2 · 2014 · Crayon Shin-chan: Intense Battle! Robo Dad Strikes Back
metas.description: A high tech company which specialises in making robots for construction turns Hiroshi nohara in a robot who then along with shinosuke fights to reclaim his original body fighting other robots.

metas.name: 23 · ★ 6.7 · 2015 · Crayon Shin-chan Movie 23: Ora No Hikkoshi Monogatari - Saboten Daisuugeki

metas.description: During his sleep, Shinnosuke enters a fantasy world where he could find all his favorite things, starting from chocolates, cakes and candies to young and beautiful girls in voluptuous and salacious clothes. But it soon turns out t...

metas.name: 25 · ★ 6.1 · 2017 · Crayon Shin-chan: Invasion!! Alien Shiriri
metas.description: The Nohara family encounters an alien named Shiriri who accidentally turns the parents into kids. They must find Shiriri's father, leading to an adventure spanning Japan.

metas.name: 26 · ★ 6.2 · 2018 · Crayon Shin-chan: Burst Serving! Kung Fu Boys - Ramen Rebellion

metas.name: 29 · ★ 7.1 · 2021 · Crayon Shin-chan: Shrouded in Mystery! The Flowers of Tenkazu Academy

metas.name: 30 · ★ 6.9 · 2022 · Crayon Shin-chan: Mononoke Ninja Chinpuden
metas.description: The film features Shinnosuke as a ninja, and will reveal if Shinnosuke is the real son of Hiroshi and Misae.

metas.name: 31 · ★ 6.5 · 2023 · Shin Jigen! Crayon Shin-chan the Movie
metas.description: Young boy Shinnosuke gains telekinetic abilities from cosmic white light. Mitsuru Hiriya obtains psychic powers from black light, aims to destroy Earth. Amidst Japan's fear, Shinnosuke emerges as hero against Hiriya's threat.
